# Switch

An n-way router for the flow of the program. While enabled it reads **Selector**, rounds it to a whole number and drives the output with that index (0 to 15). All the other outputs are switched off.

## Pins

| Pin | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Selector (required) | A whole number or anything that converts to one. |
| Branch 0..n | One flow output per case; add as many as you need (up to 16). Wire each to the enables of the blocks of that case. |
| ENO | Active while a branch was taken. |

## Behaviour

- A selector below 0 or past the last branch drives **no** output.
- Disabled block or an unreadable selector: no output, ENO off.
- The block has no state.
